Optimal.Notes: 40 Hz refresh with a matching frame cap gives smooth, tear-free gameplay that the Deck GPU can sustain through typical dungeon encounters. FSR at 80% render scale recovers image quality lost from sub-native rendering.

profiles.Summary: Dark and Darker is a demanding hardcore FPS dungeon crawler that runs at or slightly above its minimum PC spec on the Steam Deck, requiring reduced settings and FSR upscaling to maintain a playable frame rate. The game is rated Playable on Steam Deck with gold-tier ProtonDB reports, suggesting it works but may need some tweaking around controller support and UI readability.
profiles.BasisNote: No Steam Deck-specific player reports were found; profiles are estimated from the PC minimum requirements (GTX 1060 / RX 580) compared to the Deck's RDNA 2 GPU (roughly GTX 1050 Ti class). On your first run, check frame rate in a busy dungeon room or during PvP and drop to Optimal or Max Battery if it dips below 30 fps.

MaxPerformance.Notes: Full TDP with automatic GPU clocks and native resolution targets the highest possible frame rate, but expect drops into the 40s in busy PvP encounters or large dungeon rooms. Battery life will be short; best used while plugged in or for short sessions.

Optimal.Notes: The 40 Hz refresh/40 fps cap is the sweet spot for this hardware tier — motion is noticeably smoother than 30 fps and the 12 W TDP keeps thermals comfortable. Texture Quality bumped to Medium gives dungeon surfaces better definition without a significant GPU cost.
